name: AIND-metadata-bench
description: AIND-metadata-bench evaluates models' ability to produce and validate dataset metadata. It focuses on tasks such as extracting structured metadata fields, classifying metadata attributes, and detecting inconsistencies or missing metadata across records. The benchmark is intended to measure robustness and generalization of models on metadata-related information tasks.
reputation: A niche Hugging Face benchmark with limited but growing use among researchers focused on dataset/metadata quality and extraction.
